# Kartikeya Sharma

> Personal portfolio site for Kartikeya Sharma, a security researcher focused on Agentic AI, Graph Neural Networks, threat detection, cybersecurity talks, and applied research.

This website is a static single-page portfolio. The homepage presents the content through client-rendered timeline and modal views, but the most authoritative structured information lives in JSON files under `/data/`.

For factual questions about work history, projects, publications, talks, education, or service, prefer the JSON files over the rendered homepage HTML. For long-form technical writing, use the blog page under `/blogs/`.

This site does not currently publish Markdown mirrors of its pages. When a shorter context is needed, skip the `Optional` section.

## Primary Content

- [Home page](/index.html): Main portfolio landing page with profile summary, featured items, and access to all timeline categories.
- [Work experience data](/data/work-experience.json): Structured employment history with roles, dates, achievements, locations, and technology stacks.
- [Projects data](/data/projects.json): Structured project portfolio with descriptions, repositories, deployed links, images, and tech stacks.
- [Publications data](/data/publications.json): Research papers and blog entries, including summaries and links to detailed content.
- [Talks data](/data/talks.json): Conference talks with abstracts, slide links, recordings, venues, and dates.
- [Education data](/data/education.json): Academic background, coursework, and research or class projects.
- [Service and leadership data](/data/leadership.json): Reviewer and service activity history.

## Long-form Content

- [Graph Neural Networks for Enhanced DDoS Attack Detection](/blogs/gnn-ddos-detection.html): Detailed technical article on using graph neural networks for DDoS detection.

## Optional

- [Client-side renderer](/js/render.js): Explains how the site loads JSON datasets and renders the timeline and modal content.
- [Interaction logic](/js/website.js): Handles modal lifecycle, filters, section switching, and mobile behavior.
- [Landing page styles](/css/landing.css): Visual design for the homepage and landing sections.
- [Main site styles](/css/website.css): Shared modal, timeline, and content styling.
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/kartikeyas00): Additional source repositories related to projects and experiments.
- [LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kart1/): External professional profile.
